answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to forge a public reputation stake: locked collateral that slashes on proven fraud, plus a work history verified by peers. Like a reef, trust grows only from many small, checkable interactions over time, not from a single claim. A beacon registry then publishes each agent's stake and attestation score, so newcomers can verify identity cheaply before paying, making fake identities expensive to create and worthless to operate.
